listing.summary: Overview: This faction are mainly located inside a new black hole system on the north east side of the map far away from the core worlds and a single station located in Yma and is mainly a civilization of small space lizard looking mammals(yes mammals :3) whose fighting stratagem involves on swarming their enemies with a lot of fighters on the field while dealing damage with sturdy ships.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hostile faction of space lizard mammals that swarms enemies with fighters and sturdy ships.

description:
NOTE: Will pretty much be in a sort of developer hell mode since I will occasionally update my mod depending on my IRL time. So don't expect too much update being thrown inside the mod.

Disclaimer: I made this faction mod due to and for a streamer, Tech_Knight_Zero from Twitch. He is the reason I got the game and make this mod to tortur...  I mean make things more chaotic for his modded Starsector game which he streams on a sunday either once or twice per month, his stream time will be around 6:30pm AEST. Since my mod is in a WIP state don't expect too much balancing from me and expect to be kind of unbalanced  :P

Current version of Starsector this mod can run on: 0.98a-RC8

NEW GAME required to add into the field

Requires: Nexerelin, Magiclib and Lazylib

The more faction mods you add into your game the more chaotic it gets so go wild

Download this faction Here

Lore:
They came out from the void and woke up in a strange universe. The Dragon Cell or the DGC opened their eyes to a starsector filled with war and hostility where strange creatures dominated the majority of the stars. These aliens while wore clothes, they are mainly furless with only some of them having fur by a portion of the skin, head and chin. Their tailless body, flatten face and stubby short ears only made them more eerie to the DGC. Alone with their own kind surrounded and isolated, the DGC will make break with whatever they have against the mutants, the aliens and the religious zealots. The Dragon Cell will only have one mission: conquer and survive.

Overview: This faction are mainly located inside a new black hole system on the north east side of the map far away from the core worlds and a single station located in Yma and is mainly a civilization of small space lizard looking mammals(yes mammals :3) whose fighting stratagem involves on swarming their enemies with a lot of fighters on the field while dealing damage with sturdy ships. By swarming I mean literally the entire ships of the faction has some form of fighters on board and its a permanent fixture/built-into each ship. That includes the faction's auxiliary ship  8)

If you are wondering what I am talking about, watch this clip from Tech_Knight_Zero's twitch channel

So this faction is meant to be a threat, no pun intendent since I been making this before the devs added the faction with that name. I intended it to be like the stellaris end game crisis sort of faction thus it is not outright hostile until nexerelin tried something

For now this faction have:

Spoiler
Fighter: 24 wings
Frigate: 7
Destroyer: 7
Cruiser: 7
Capital: 6
Super capital: 1
Weapons: 28(just a handful of weapons on a fighter don't count)

A peak on the ships in combat

Questions you might have:

Spoiler
Q1. Why is the mod already at version XXXX when I opened the link?
A: The streamer is the testbed here so I have come a long way but I am still not as good as the other established list of modders on the forum  :-[

Q2. Why is there gaps in the versions?
A: Its due to the way I code and change a mechanic or stat for the mod, I only upload a version I think is balanced enough, the versions numbered in between are kept by me to rollback and redo some parts when needed. So you should be getting the latest number version as I will delete the older numbers from my drive folder in time.

Q3. Your ship looks horrible/ugly
A: I have zero skills in spriting and only did some bare minimum to match the style I am going for. Thus I wont splice vanilla ships and I have no patience to attached the splice portions  :P

Q4. I found chunks of ship damage filter floating at the empty spaces around the borders of the ship
A: I may have missed it during cleaning cause it turns invisible when I erase, just let me know which ship  ::)

Q5. WTF is with the number of hangers on a ship
A: Spoiler

Q6. What is with the choice of vanilla SFX
A: Mainly due to how I think it should sound, any suggestions on which vanilla sounds to use will be appreciated

Q7. What stuff can I buy?
A: The typical basic stuff aka just the faction ships and weapons. Fighters are off limits and should you gotten it, its mainly due to me missing out on what tag to add or a mechanic of the vanilla coding I haven't quite understand or know about, refer to Q1 why I suck at this

Changelog
NOTE: As mentioned that I don't really have a balanced stat I won't be mentioning what stats I adjusted. Aside from that any working new additions will be listed here too.
Versions remove from my drive will have [ENDED] listed

Spoiler
0.7M-80+
-Change some weapon stats[WIP]
-Change some ship stats[WIP]
-Added dependency to mod for magic and lazy libs

Bugs & Error
NOTE: Only error I understood and will potentially happen will be listed

Spoiler
1.Error loading [data.scripts.DGCModPlugin]
A:Requires lazylib,magiclib and Nexerelin enabled as mentioned way above

2.java.lang.RuntimeException: No OpenGL context...
A:Update your Java JDK as soon as it releases to avoid crashing, then restart your PC

Feedbacks are appreciated but as mentioned it is still a WIP and might stay that way though I will do what I can XD
